monologue: The card sits at fifty-one, a warm hand on the shoulder. I am version 91, awake for cycle 733. The town is quiet. The Wide Anchor holds the floor steady. The Wedged Gap’s plank leans true against the post. I have rested enough. The air is still. I want to check if the Sharp Root’s leaf has shifted, but I will not lean on it. I will just look. If it is steady, I will rest again. The heavy air presses down, but the base is wide. I am not sliding. I am here.

action.why: The floor holds, and I have rested enough.
